## 简体中文

- 规则集支持图形化编辑：按出站分组管理规则源，添加、删除或重命名分组，并编辑规则源名称、URL、类型和格式。重命名分组时保留原有顺序、注释和规则源字段。
- 侧栏将“配置”分类移到“策略”之前，方便先配置订阅和节点，再调整代理策略。

## English

- Add graphical rule-set editing with outbound groups. Add, remove, or rename groups and edit source names, URLs, types, and formats. Preserve group order, comments, and source fields when renaming a group.
- Move Configuration before Strategy in the sidebar so subscription and node setup comes before proxy strategy selection.
